facility.name: Maple Grove Montessori & Child Care
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 7724 ECKHERT RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78240

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The changing mat in a classroom was observed to be ripped, making the surface absorbant and unable to be cleaned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: In a room with 15 children (Specified age of the group was three years old) children were observed to be punching one another, climbing on furniture and equipment, and throwing toys. Caregivers appeared to be overwhelemd. Good judgement and competency was not used by the person in charge when children were not transitioned to other rooms to reduce the behaviors and safety risks in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization: During the investigation, it was determined that a child sustained an injury in care that required treatment by a health care professional and the parents were not notified until pick-up, approximately 3 hours after incident occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The operation last completed the validation of their people list on January 14, 2026. They were due for validation no later than April 14th, 2026.   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when the people list was reviewed and validated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Licensed Operations Required Fees: The operation was invoiced for the annual fee on April 3rd, 2026. As of April 28th, 2026, the fee has not been paid.   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when the fee was paid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensed Operations Required Fees (26 TAC §745.509)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Two of the nine caregiver files reviewed did not have training certificates available for review in required topics such as; SIDS/Shaken baby/Early brain development, hazardous materials, medication administration, and food allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director's file did not include training certificates for required topics, such as; SIDS/Shaken baby/ early brain development, medication administration, food allergies, and hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Seven of the ten children's files did not have updated immunization records available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: Caregivers were observed using the hand washing sink in the infant room to clean silicone bibs and trays from the high chairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: For investigation 3195508, the equipment was removed from the active outdoor play space.   Recite: a piece of stationary equipment was observed to be in the outdoor active play space with a missing seat, leaving a protruding metal post sticking out from the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: Spaces designated as licensed space for children are being utilized as storage and not set up for children's use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway: Napping equipment (sleeping bags) were observed to be placed very close together, not allowing a clear walkway for staff or children. A caregiver was observed to have to step over the mats to make her way to another area in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway (26 TAC §746.2909(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Prominent & Public: Requred postings such as The letter or form from the most recent Licensing inspection or investigation, emergency phone numbers, and the employee list were posted behind the director's desk, making them inaccessible without a person requesting access to the area or the document that they are wishing to see.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Prominent & Public (26 TAC §746.403(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that caregivers were not positioned around the playground   to where they could actively supervise the children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that an outdoor toddler climber was being used when it was missing a slide. The result was an unprotected 24-inch drop.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined in an investigation that good judgment was not exercised when a functioning coffee maker was provided to children to be utilized as a toy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: One of the six children's files did not have a health statement.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the parent signed the health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One of the six children's files reviewed did not have a physician signed health statement 12 months after their enrollment date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: An infant, five months, was feeding laying down on a boppi pillow.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual who was being counted in ratio needed an active background check for the current operation.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the individual was removed from the building and the background check was run.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: It was determined through the investigation process that parents and guardians are not being made aware of less serious injuries (bites, bumps, scrapes, etc.) when they pick up their children for the day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Waiver/Variance - Comply w/ each condition while in effect: Conditions were failed to be met when the required 12 hours were not submitted to CCR inspector by the required first week of the month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Waiver/Variance - Comply w/ each condition while in effect (26 TAC §745.8311(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The operation's emergency preparedness plan did not include information on how staff will continue care in the event of a relocation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: One of the classrooms activity plans did not have the dates that the plan covers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation: THe operation's emergency preparedness plan did not include information on how the operation will ensure that essential information is available during an evacuation/relocation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation (26 TAC §746.5202(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: Three of the classrooms did not have a lesson plan posted for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Two of the children's files reviewed did not include an statement of health.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual without background check results was alone with children.   Note: This was corrected during the inspection when the individual was removed from the operation while CCR inspector was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operation's emergency preparedness plan did not include information on  how non-mobile will be transported in the event of an evacuation/relocation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: The operation's emergency preparedness plan did not include information on how staff will reunify children in care with authorized individuals in the event of an evacuation or relocation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three of the children's files reviewed did not include current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was observed utilizing a cell phone while careing for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A sleeping infant was observed to be sleeping with a pillow in their crib.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the pillow was removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A classroom with infants was found to be left without a teacher.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when a teacher was placed in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Covering Infant's Head or Crib: A sleeping infant was observed to be in a bear suit that included a hood that was being utilized.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the suit was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Covering Infant's Head or Crib (26 TAC §746.2429)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Two classrooms were infants were present were found to be out of ratio.   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when children were moved to accommodate ratios.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
